turns.query: Using the retained 2025-Q3 FFIEC Call Report for JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., compare its standardized-approach and advanced-approaches common equity tier 1 risk-based capital measures. Report the bank's RSSD ID, common equity tier 1 capital and each approach's risk-weighted assets, then calculate both ratios. Use the current FFIEC NIC structure snapshot observed on 2026-08-13 to identify the bank's immediate parent in the 2025 Federal Reserve Supervisory Severely Adverse stress-test results; report that parent's legal name, RSSD ID and NIC entity type, the actual-ratio date, and its actual and projected-minimum common equity tier 1 ratios. Explain what each comparison measures and what reading them together does and does not establish.
